events.title: Beware… HERE COMES THE HORDE
events.summary: My liege!A grave peril has come upon thy Kingdom. Pure evil stands at our doorstep. Moriana, your former Lady Chamberlain, whom Your Majesty banished for her sinful experiments with necromancy, has returned. And she comes not alone… Vast armies of the undead march slowly but surely toward our walls.We must defend the crown! We shall gladly stand at your side on the battlefield and… What?... What do you mean you’re not coming? My King, your presence would inspire the people to… Fine. As you wish.
